review:
Bonanza's spicy follow-up, with one big decision: when free spins trigger, you can gamble them on a wheel for more. Unlimited multipliers are still the core.

In the base game it plays like most Megaways – lots of small cascades, the odd decent hit when chillies line up, and long gaps between bonuses. The gamble can turn 8 spins into 24, but a miss loses the bonus completely. Try both ways in demo. High volatility, 20,000x max and a strong 96.82% RTP.
cons: Gamble wheel can lose the bonus entirely
